name: cli-agents
description: Consolidated CLI sub-agent system — dispatches persona-based analysis and task execution to Claude CLI (haiku-4.5), GitHub Copilot (gpt-5-mini), Gemini CLI (gemini-3-flash-preview), and Antigravity agy (frontier Gemini 3.5 Flash+). Includes project setup scaffolding for Claude and Antigravity environments.
